notes.title: Air Traffic Disruptor got it's FIRST UPDATE
notes.content: Air Traffic Disruptor finally recieved it's first update by adding the high score tracker along with some bug fixes! Can you beat my high score in insane mode? It's currently 17 seconds! ːsteamhappyː
